clue.text: Stand in the way of blow

definitions.meaning: to thwart or oppose someone's plans
a punch thrown across the body in boxing

explanation.surface: Someone is told to block a punch.
explanation.definitionFit: To thwart is to obstruct, and in boxing a hooked punch over the opponent's lead is a blow of that name.

clue.text: Alternative suggestion from bartender?

parts.note: a bartender serves from behind the bar's counter, so whatever the barman suggests comes from there; seriously, an alternative offer made in reply to another

explanation.surface: A barman suggests something else to drink.
explanation.definitionFit: A rival offer put forward in response to an earlier one is exactly an alternative suggestion.

clue.text: Veteran fighter's content

indicators.note: the contents of something are its inside, so the fighter's word is stripped of its first and last letters

parts.note: a soldier is a fighter

explanation.surface: An old soldier is satisfied with his lot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'content' looks like 'happy', but it means the inside of SOLDIER once its first and last letters go.
explanation.definitionFit: Informally an old-timer or veteran is called by this word, also used of old songs and films.

clue.text: Fail to keep appointment with comedian

definitions.meaning: to leave a date waiting, never turning up
a comic who performs solo before an audience

explanation.surface: A comic misses a meeting.
explanation.definitionFit: To leave someone waiting on a date is to jilt them this way, and the hyphenated noun is a solo comic.

clue.text: Performing thus as a top jazz songstress, without piano

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside: the piano letter stands outside the singer's name

parts.note: a cap is a top or lid
p is the musical abbreviation for piano, softly
Ella Fitzgerald, the great jazz singer

explanation.surface: Someone sings like a jazz star, with no piano accompaniment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without piano' reads as the meaning of the answer, but 'without' is used as 'outside', putting P next to ELLA. 'as' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Singing without instrumental accompaniment is performing in this Italian-derived manner, which the surface describes.

clue.text: Peculiar speech heard in old vessel

indicators.note: heard tells us the slang word is said aloud, and its final T is silent

parts.note: argot is the jargon peculiar to a group

explanation.surface: Odd talk was overheard aboard an ancient ship.
explanation.walkthrough: ARGOT is pronounced with a silent T, so it sounds like ARGO.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth Jason and his Argonauts sailed in a ship of this name, so it is an old vessel.

clue.text: Take part in King Lear? Don't be serious!

definitions.meaning: to play the role of Lear's jester, the Fool, a character in the play
to clown about and behave frivolously

explanation.surface: An actor is cast in Shakespeare's tragedy and told to lighten up.
explanation.definitionFit: Clowning around is behaving like a jester, and in King Lear the jester's role is a part one can play.

clue.text: Succeed with right, having succeeded in centre

indicators.note: in centre places the letter in the middle of the word for right

parts.note: proper means correct or right
s is the abbreviation for succeeded, used in genealogies

explanation.surface: Someone thrives by being correct, after taking over at the middle.
explanation.definitionFit: To thrive or do well is to succeed in life.

clue.text: Most stupid, in 8, at any rate

definitions.meaning: read as two words, the ... person is the most stupid
an American colloquialism meaning at least or anyway

explanation.surface: The dimmest person, in the American variety of English, at least.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in 8' points to entry 8, AMERICAN ENGLISH, where this word is used to mean 'at any rate'.
explanation.definitionFit: Split in two it means having the least wisdom; as one word it is a North American colloquial adverb meaning anyway.

clue.text: In which non-U behaviour is standard

definitions.text: In which non-U behaviour is standard

parts.words: In which non-U behaviour is standard
parts.note: non-U looks like the British label for lower-class manners, but it means the word behaviour spelt without its U, which is the normal spelling across the Atlantic

explanation.surface: A social setting where common manners are the norm.
explanation.walkthrough: Non-U is a British term for speech or manners not used by the upper class.
explanation.definitionFit: Transatlantic spelling drops the U from words like behaviour, so behavior is the standard form in that variety.

clue.text: Current rising, hence increased amount of fish

parts.note: up means increased, as in prices being up
a draught is the quantity of fish caught in one haul of the net

explanation.surface: A rising current brings a bigger catch.
explanation.definitionFit: An upward-moving current of air is a rising current.

clue.text: American people love someone who's wise

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, the letter O
a sage is a wise person

explanation.surface: Americans love a wise person.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a Native American tribe, originally of the Missouri valley.

clue.text: Attempt to hold object in

indicators.note: to hold means the word for attempt surrounds the other piece

parts.note: a try is an attempt
an end is an aim or object

explanation.surface: Someone tries to keep something inside.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is the last word: 'in' as in fashionable.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that is in is currently fashionable, the same as stylish.

clue.text: Bread and tea with famous soprano

parts.note: cha is slang for tea
Adelina Patti, the celebrated 19th-century soprano

explanation.surface: Bread and tea served alongside a renowned singer.
explanation.definitionFit: This is an unleavened flatbread from South Asia.

clue.text: Joined service and went overseas after rising dispute

indicators.note: after places the word for went overseas behind the turned word
rising in a down clue means the word is read upwards, so backwards

parts.note: a row is a dispute
shipped means sent or went by sea

explanation.surface: Someone joined the forces and was posted abroad after an argument.
explanation.definitionFit: To attend a church service is to join in worship, so joined service means took part in it.

clue.text: Like protective cover artist in demonstration needed

parts.note: RA, Royal Academician, is an artist
a proof is a demonstration that something is true

explanation.surface: An artist needs evidence of protective covering.
explanation.definitionFit: A cover that keeps out the weather is waterproof against showers.

clue.text: List of items at home, not very, organised

parts.note: in means at home

indicators.note: organised means the letters are arranged into a new order

explanation.surface: A list of items in the house, put together not very well.
explanation.definitionFit: A detailed itemised list of goods is a stock list.

clue.text: Upset at air fare from India.

indicators.note: upset means the letters are knocked over into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone is upset by airline food from India.
explanation.definitionFit: This yoghurt dish is a side served with Indian food, so it is fare from that country.

clue.text: Little time after split to join securely

indicators.note: after puts the time abbreviation behind the word for split

parts.note: to rive is to split or tear apart
t is a short abbreviation for time

explanation.surface: Shortly after a break, someone tries to fix things firmly.
explanation.definitionFit: To fasten with metal pins hammered flat is to join securely.

clue.text: Passion in West End about plays

indicators.note: in means the passion word sits inside the other letters
end means the final letter of the word West

parts.note: re means about or concerning
heat means passion

explanation.surface: Passion in London's West End concerns its plays.
explanation.walkthrough: The West End is London's main theatre district, which the surface leans on. 'End' gives T, the last letter of West.
explanation.definitionFit: Drama as an art form is the stage, so plays in general are this.

clue.text: Theatrical part that's particularly fine, for example

parts.note: show is a theatrical production, used as a modifier
a piece is a part

explanation.surface: A theatrical role that is especially good.
explanation.definitionFit: An outstanding item put on display is an especially fine example of its kind.

clue.text: Instructions for PC, say, supporting good force

parts.note: pro means in favour of or supporting
to ram is to force

explanation.surface: Computer instructions backing a strong force.
explanation.definitionFit: Software, the set of coded instructions run on a computer, is spelt this way in computing.

clue.text: Cause of very widespread ill-feeling

parts.note: ill-feeling reads as resentment, but here it is literal sickness felt across a whole population

explanation.surface: Something causes resentment everywhere.
explanation.definitionFit: A disease outbreak spreading across countries makes vast numbers feel ill.

clue.text: First to follow leader

parts.note: top means first or best
to dog someone is to follow them closely

explanation.surface: Someone is the first to follow the leader.
explanation.definitionFit: The dominant person in a group is its leader.

clue.text: A number of disciples practise contemplative religion

parts.note: to do something is to practise it
Zen is the meditative school of Buddhism

explanation.surface: Disciples practise a meditative faith.
explanation.definitionFit: There were twelve disciples, and twelve is this number.

clue.text: Drive on side road

definitions.meaning: a branch road or rail line leading off the main one

explanation.surface: A driver keeps going along a minor road.
explanation.definitionFit: To spur a horse is to drive it on, and a short branch road is also called this.

clue.text: Cause to blow a fuse, perhaps, being uncivil

definitions.text: Cause to blow a fuse, perhaps

explanation.surface: Someone rude makes another lose their temper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'blow a fuse' looks like losing one's temper but is literal electrics; 'being' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: A short circuit blows fuses, and a curt reply is brusque or rude.

clue.text: They specialise in shooting stars

parts.note: shooting stars suggests meteors, but here the stars are celebrities and the shooting is with a camera

explanation.surface: Some people are experts in meteors.
explanation.definitionFit: Freelance photographers who pursue celebrities take pictures of famous people.

clue.text: Over a year, chief assistant to minister

indicators.note: over means the chief's word lies over, or covers, the other letters

parts.note: a leader is a chief

explanation.surface: After more than a year, the boss assists a cleric.
explanation.definitionFit: A layperson licensed to conduct parts of services helps the parish minister.

clue.text: Painter exhibiting a lot around North

indicators.note: around means the word for a lot surrounds the letter

parts.note: much means a lot

explanation.surface: An artist shows a lot of work about the north.
explanation.walkthrough: 'exhibiting' is a link word. Edvard Munch was the Norwegian painter of The Scream.
explanation.definitionFit: Edvard Munch was a Norwegian painter.
